messages:
neha: dropping a concise decision thread for the observability console slice. Customer asks stacked up: route-level cost visibility, lightweight trace hook for linking to tracing systems, and smarter error grouping to reduce noise. I mapped three launch options; want a quick pick so eng can scope Q2 sprint.

luca: the options I sketched: A) "View": dashboards + coarse cost estimate (no traces), B) "Linkable": dashboards + trace hook API + basic error grouping, C) "Full": everything + per-tenant detailed billing and span-level UI. My vote: B (Linkable).

tara: B seems like the sweet spot for impact vs effort. It gives customers the links they ask for without forcing full billing infra. Need clear acceptance criteria though.

morgan: suggested acceptance criteria: dashboards deployed, cost widget shows route/model breakdown with +/-10% confidence, trace hook API documented and testable, error grouping reduces noise by at least 60% in canary.

neha: agree. Also propose telemetry cost guardrail: default sampling 0.5% global, allow Dedicated customers to bump to 5% via console toggle. UI should estimate token delta before they flip it.

luca: UX idea: when enabling higher sampling, show a projected monthly tokens chart and an inline confirm checkbox: "I understand this may increase my usage costs". keeps legal simple.

tara: implementation notes for trace hook: runtime emits a lightweight header when sampled. Pseudocode: ```
if (sampled) {
  response.headers['x-redwood-span'] = spanId
  emitMetric('trace.forwarded', {route, tenant, sampled: true})
}
```

morgan: cost attribution: runtime must attach meta {route_id, model_name, tokens_in, tokens_out} to telemetry events. For launch, we can aggregate nightly to compute per-route spend. Put a confidence band on UI and a note: "best-effort attribution".

neha: risks: higher telemetry volume, inaccurate attribution for multi-model pipelines, and UX confusion. Mitigations: cap raw payload retention to 7 days, expose confidence interval, and hide per-span UI in v1 (only provide links to external tracing).

luca: launch checklist candidate: - E2E dashboards - route & model cost widget + confidence band - trace hook API + SDK snippet - error grouping heuristics + integration tests - 2-week canary with 6 customers - ops runbook and rollback plan.

tara: canary plan: recruit 6 customers (3 PLG, 2 growth, 1 Dedicated). Monitor signals: token delta, dashboard query latency, error-group false positives. Abort criteria: token delta > 40% or query latency > 200ms p95.

neha: owners: Product: neha, Runtime: luca, Platform: morgan, Docs: tara. Deploy-bot will monitor canary and post alerts.

morgan: dev spike estimates: schema changes (1.5d), trace hook (2d), cost aggregation job + dashboard (3d), error grouping + tests (2d). Roughly 9-10 engineer days if parallelized.

luca: dependency: runtime needs to expose model token counts reliably. I'll open a runtime PR to emit tokens per request. Also coordinate with infra on short-term retention limits.

neha: decision: go with Linkable (B). Action items: luca open telemetry PR today; morgan create dashboard tickets; tara draft user-facing copy and docs examples. Please drop reactions to confirm.

luca: :thumbsup:

tara: :thumbsup:

morgan: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: CANARY SCHEDULED: canary start 1717240000 for 6 customers. Will post health checks and token deltas.

neha: thanks team. I'll add acceptance criteria to the roadmap doc and spin up a stakeholder sync. Parking-lot: per-tenant billing UI and full span viewer for later releases.
